name: Galaxies: GALM timeline (2240 to 2380, tech 1/4/7/10/14), Dominion Alliance and Borg era lines

highTechnologies.name: Genomic Synthesis
highTechnologies.description: Designing living tissue from first principles. Colonies feed more people from less land and medicine outruns most plagues.

highTechnologies.name: Symbiotic Ecology
highTechnologies.description: Whole ecosystems built to cooperate with the people living inside them. Hostile worlds become gentle slowly.

highTechnologies.name: Biosphere Engineering
highTechnologies.description: Entire planetary biospheres planned, seeded and tuned from orbit. A dead rock can be a garden within a generation.

highTechnologies.name: Transcendent Biology
highTechnologies.description: Life redesigned past its natural limits. Few limits on food and growth remain.

highTechnologies.name: Bio-Neural Circuitry
highTechnologies.description: Ship and colony computers that grow, heal and learn like living tissue. Research and intelligence work both speed up.

highTechnologies.name: Isomorphic Cognition
highTechnologies.description: Reasoning that holds contradictory models at once and picks the better. Analysts reach conclusions in hours, not months.

highTechnologies.name: Holographic Cores
highTechnologies.description: Whole laboratories simulated in light, then built once they work. Dead ends cost almost nothing to explore.

highTechnologies.name: Distributed Sentience
highTechnologies.description: Machine minds that share one thought across a fleet. Little of the original information gap is left to close.

highTechnologies.name: Molecular Lattices
highTechnologies.description: Hull and structure materials ordered atom by atom. Ships carry more armour for the same mass.

highTechnologies.name: Self-Repairing Hulls
highTechnologies.description: Structures that mend their own damage under way. Repair crews work less and fleets stay in the field longer.

highTechnologies.name: Nanostructure Fabrication
highTechnologies.description: Nano-scale assembly builds components in place. Shipyards turn out hulls that earlier ones could not hold together.

highTechnologies.name: Programmable Matter
highTechnologies.description: Matter shaped on command to any form a design calls for. Construction is limited by imagination, not materials.

highTechnologies.name: Zero-Point Taps
highTechnologies.description: Power drawn directly from the structure of space. Colonies run hot on almost nothing.

highTechnologies.name: Quantum Reactors
highTechnologies.description: Compact reactors with enormous output. The power grid stops being the limit on a colony.

highTechnologies.name: Subspace Capacitance
highTechnologies.description: Energy stored and moved through subspace itself. Power can be shared across a whole empire.

highTechnologies.name: Singularity Cores
highTechnologies.description: Controlled singularities as fuel. The last great leap in energy that engineers can name.

highTechnologies.name: Slipstream Theory
highTechnologies.description: A new theory of travel through folded subspace. Ships are far faster than warp, though the lanes are narrow.

highTechnologies.name: Transwarp Conduits
highTechnologies.description: Permanent conduits make a network of fast lanes. Supply lines stretch much farther than before.

highTechnologies.name: Quantum Slipstream
highTechnologies.description: Individual ships carve their own lanes at will. Distance stops mattering for those who master it.

highTechnologies.name: Spatial Folding
highTechnologies.description: Space itself folded so two places touch. Ships arrive almost the moment they leave.

highTechnologies.name: Resonant Beams
highTechnologies.description: Beams tuned to resonate with a target's own structure. Armour stops mattering as much as it did.

highTechnologies.name: Multi-Spectral Arrays
highTechnologies.description: Weapons that fire across the whole spectrum at once. No shield frequency holds for long against them.

highTechnologies.name: Variable-Yield Warheads
highTechnologies.description: Warheads that choose their yield after launch. A single volley is right for any target.

highTechnologies.name: Temporal Lock Targeting
highTechnologies.description: Weapons that fire at where a target will be and not where it is. Few ships escape a lock once it is made.
